exposure: neonates born to mothers who received remifentanil analgesia
neonates born to mothers who received epidural analgesia
outcome: neonatal complications (perinatal asphyxia, respiratory distress, infection, hyperbilirubinemia, birth injuries)
finding: There was no statistically significant difference in mean Apgar scores and neonatal complications between neonates who received epidural vs. remifentanil analgesia.
mod_finding: Neonates born by cesarean delivery had significantly worse outcomes than those born vaginally.
